sentence: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
answer:
But Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force.

但蒂娜·罗森伯格认为，同伴压力也可以成为积极力量。

◆ 补充信息

in her new book Join the Club
在她名为《加入俱乐部》的新书中，交代言论出处

through what she calls the social cure
通过她所称的“社会疗法”这一途径

◆ 难点拆解：社会疗法如何运作

in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics
在这种社会疗法中，组织和官员利用群体动力的力量

to help individuals
目的是帮助个人

improve their lives and possibly the world
改善他们的生活，甚至可能改善世界
